CustomField.description: The issuer string (SAML entity ID or OIDC client ID) this Application uses to authenticate with Login.gov. Not unique: the same string can appear under more than one Application when it has moved between them.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The SAML entity ID or OIDC client ID registered for this Application. The same string may appear on another Application it was previously or later assigned to.
CustomField.label: Issuer String
